pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients on the flank, transitioning to larger, more angular blocks on the lower neck. Geometric shapes exhibit high perimeter-to-area ratios with straight and slightly curved segments.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial or quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent, maintaining high topological continuity across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D profile against the background. Individual hair clusters create a micro-sawtooth texture along the dorsal line from the mid-neck to the shoulder.
